name: Philips India
description: Philips India Limited (CIN U31902WB1930PLC006663) is an unlisted public company registered with the MCA in Newtown, Kolkata, and a subsidiary of Royal Philips (Euronext: PHIA). Health Systems (50.4%), Innovation Services (36%) and Personal Health (12.5%) make up the FY25 revenue mix.

stock.note: Unlisted in India. Parent Royal Philips (Euronext: PHIA) FY25 revenue €17.8bn, returned to profit (€897m) — reflects the global business, not India specifically.

marketing_spend.derivation: Files Schedule III accounts but no advertising line surfaced in available aggregator snippets, and the brand doesn't appear in PMAR's top-10. Personal Health is only ~12.5% of ₹6,630 crore revenue (~₹829 crore); at a 5-8% consumer A&P ratio → ~₹40-66 crore. Adding B2B healthcare brand-building spend on top gives a triangulated ₹50-120 crore for FY25 — the lowest-confidence tier, pending a direct pull of the Schedule III notes.
